name: build-gaia/php-collector
description: Chronos telemetry collector SDK for PHP. Thin span-decoration API over the native Rust extension.

suggest.laravel/framework: Required for automatic Laravel HTTP instrumentation
suggest.monolog/monolog: Lets ChronosHandler ship Monolog records to the collector's log pipeline
suggest.psr/log: Lets ChronosLogger decorate any PSR-3 logger to capture its records
suggest.doctrine/dbal: Lets the Doctrine ChronosMiddleware (DBAL 3/4) or ChronosSqlLogger (DBAL 2) emit SQL client spans
suggest.symfony/messenger: Lets the Messenger ChronosMiddleware propagate traces across buses and trace message handling
suggest.bunny/bunny: Lets BunnyTelemetry propagate traces across an AMQP publish and trace consumed messages
suggest.symfony/http-client: Lets ChronosHttpClient decorate Symfony's HTTP client with spans and trace propagation
suggest.psr/http-client: Lets ChronosClientDecorator wrap any PSR-18 client with spans and trace propagation
